hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "kitchen: not inside a git repository" >&2; exit 2; }; s="$r/.codex/hooks.json"; h="$r/.kitchen/hooks/deny-no-verify"; [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || exit 0; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "kitchen: guard missing: $h" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$h"'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "kitchen: not inside a git repository" >&2; exit 2; }; s="$r/.codex/hooks.json"; h="$r/.kitchen/hooks/deny-recursive-rm"; [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || exit 0; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "kitchen: guard missing: $h" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$h"'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo "kitchen: not inside a git repository" >&2; exit 2; }; s="$r/.codex/hooks.json"; h="$r/.kitchen/hooks/deny-shared-push"; [ -e "$s" ] || [ -L "$s" ] || exit 0; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "kitchen: guard missing: $h" >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$h"'
